written.headline: Mistral releases weights for 1‑trillion‑parameter Le Chonk model
written.summary: Mistral AI has released the weights for its 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model, Le Chonk, citing gains in coding and cybersecurity performance. The model leads open‑weight coding benchmarks, scoring 19.7% on FrontierCode 2.0 and 48% on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index while using fewer tokens.
